description:
Jihyuk doesn’t do boyfriends, only one-night stands. So, when he’s on the prowl one night for someone to warm his bed…he gets punched in the face instead. The reason? He’s a beta and if you haven’t heard, betas aren’t exactly in demand right now. While he’s nursing his wound in the bathroom, someone falls out of one of the stalls. It is an alpha and one clearly in rut. Jihyuk is about to call the ambulance when the alpha tells him there’s only one thing he needs: a beta. Well, that can be easily arranged. But is Jihyuk prepared to get down and dirty to help the mysterious alpha? And why does the alpha look so familiar? But more importantly, will this one-night shenanigans end at that or will this force Jihyuk to break his own rules? 

(Source: Lezhin US)
